feat: migrate camellia dictionary locale and i18n pages (#40)

## Summary
- migrate `camellia` system dictionary, locale, and i18n pages from the old `woodii` baseline into React Router route modules
- add a shared authorized request layer that sends `Authorization` and `x-app`, plus login bootstrap storage for the bearer token
- integrate the new pages into the console navigation, route guards, and the newer system role shell merged from `origin/main`

## Why
- DAM-21 requires the first real foundation/admin pages in `camellia` with unified query, table, and form interaction patterns
- the migrated pages need backend-compatible field shapes while moving onto the shared `packages/ui` and `packages/api-client` primitives

## Validation
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm run check:camellia`

## Notes
- the build still emits existing Vite sourcemap warnings for `packages/ui` `select.tsx` and `table.tsx`, but the check completes successfully
